authority: User approved landing restoration plan and instructed implementation; this addendum supersedes generic redesign choices for the landing experience only.
scope: Part 1: original-code landing restoration, in-place course switch, gem launches and original map-based revision selection
designAuthority: Actual current sibling landing HTML/CSS/SVG/JS, not stale descriptive READMEs or a fresh visual approximation
requirements: Reuse original markup structure, class names, styles, SVG geometry, fonts, assets and applicable animation functions; adapt DOM/event ownership to React.
IGCSE original three year columns and 64 gems; A Level original Physical/Organic panes, L6/U6 flip, 152 visible gems (154 IDs minus two source-hidden leaves) and historical hidden aliases.
In-place IGCSE/A Level course switch using original year-toggle design; remember course and separate A Level year. Preserve explicit old course/question links.
Full display curriculum is separate from runnable activity registry; unavailable gems remain visible and do not activate new content.
Restore original details/practice choices, award/freshness visuals, focus/keyboard/dismissal/deep-link/reduced-motion/responsive behavior.
Restore map-based revision selection, chips, topic/year bulk controls where originally present, count/Clear/Cancel/GO, supported-level expansion and matching-session resume.
Typed direct launch of chosen gem+level or mastery into existing React host; no second setup screen, no duplicate attempt from effect reruns.
Home checkpoints and pauses active work, blocks departure on failed save; preserve course-separated progress and sessions.
Original Revision/Stats/Olympiad tiles; C3L6 remains A Level Olympiad-only and Rocket excluded. Preserve IGCSE eagle teacher mode and unobtrusive teacher/import access.
Original CSS scoped from generic shell; visual comparison with identical synthetic states at desktop/tablet/mobile is mandatory, not merely no-overflow checks.
outOfScope: old app writes or old browser-store writes

integrationDefaults.builds: Keep existing two static entry/build targets as entry points into same switchable application; no hosting migration required.
integrationDefaults.coursePrecedence: Explicit course/deep link, then remembered course, then entry default.
integrationDefaults.preferences: New project-owned namespaced preferences only; never write original keys.
integrationDefaults.switch: Close transient gem details; keep per-course revision selection and year preference; no cross-course evidence mixing.
integrationDefaults.history: Preserve prior accepted rebuild evidence; new validation belongs under validation/landing-restoration.

delegation.structure: Root plus one foreman, two initial implementation workers, optional one genuine exception reviewer
delegation.ownership: Design worker owns landing presentation/catalogue/progress adapter; integration worker owns host routing/launch/session handoff; foreman defines shared contracts first and integrates.
delegation.retry: One clarified retry for substantive failure, then independent exception/root disposition; routine bugs and integration fixes remain within scope.
delegation.acceptance: Root code/rendered comparison and meaningful browser/state regression; foreman manages queue/log and compact aggregate.
